mapper.sql: select task_id, user_id, task_type, workflow_id, title, product_name, selling_points, ratio, platform, region, lang, resolution, quality, model, model_key, cost_diamonds, billing_snapshot, diamond_state, result_mode, images, payload, status, progress, results, extra, result_count, retry_count, cost_ms, error_msg, finish_time, create_time, update_time from wimo_task
mapper.insert: insert into wimo_task ( user_id, task_type, workflow_id, title, product_name, selling_points, ratio, platform, region, lang, resolution, quality, model, model_key, cost_diamonds, billing_snapshot, diamond_state, result_mode, images, payload, status, progress, results, extra, result_count, retry_count, cost_ms, error_msg, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{taskType}, #{workflowId}, #{title}, #{productName}, #{sellingPoints}, #{ratio}, #{platform}, #{region}, #{lang}, #{resolution}, #{quality}, #{model}, #{modelKey}, #{costDiamonds}, #{billingSnapshot}, #{diamondState}, #{resultMode}, #{images}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{results}, #{extra}, #{resultCount}, #{retryCount}, #{costMs}, #{errorMsg}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from wimo_task where user_id = #{userId} and status = #{status}
mapper.delete: delete from wimo_task where task_id in #{taskId}
mapper.select: select status, count(*) as cnt from wimo_task group by status order by status
select task_type, count(*) as cnt from wimo_task group by task_type order by cnt desc
select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as d, count(*) as cnt from wimo_task where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by d order by d

select count(*) as total, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as done, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as failed, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as running, sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as today, round(avg(case when status = '2' then cost_ms else null end), 0) as avgCost from wimo_task
